answer: Each bonded identity escrows collateral, but detection linking equivocation across k identities triggers a correlated penalty proportional to k², rather than k independent flat fines. An exponential multiplier on capital loss, combined with asymmetric depreciation of remaining escrow, makes a coordinated sybil swarm costlier than splitting stake among aliases. The vine of linked messages exposes the swarm at the inlet; once proven, its collateral is stranded on the reef.
